Digital Twin for Asset Integrity in Delhi — NDT Data on a Live 3D Model

Atlantis NDT Digital Twin gives integrity teams in Delhi, India one 3D model of the asset with every UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and ET reading mapped to the exact location it was taken. The Delhi asset base this is built for

Delhi is the regulatory and policy capital of India, with the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO), the Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD), the Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR) authority, the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB), and the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) all headquartered here. Indian Oil Corporation's Mathura Refinery sits 150 km south, and the NCR industrial belt — including Maruti Suzuki Manesar, Hero MotoCorp Gurugram, and the Indraprastha and Pragati gas-fired power plants — drives a steady stream of pressure-equipment, piping, and weld-inspection work. NTPC's coal and gas fleet and the BHEL boiler-fabrication facility at Hardwar (NCR-adjacent) generate IBR-Form-VI evidence flows ideally suited to digital twin compliance reporting.

How the twin is built

Capture the geometry (LiDAR, photogrammetry, drone survey, or import your existing BIM/CAD and isometrics), ingest inspection data over REST API or file drop from any instrument, overlay the governing damage mechanisms per API RP 571, then publish colour-coded remaining-life and RBI views to integrity, maintenance and planning. Records are retained audit-ready under ISO 9001, ISO 17020 and ISO 17025.

Integrations

SAP PM, Oracle eAM, IBM Maximo, ServiceNow, AVEVA PI, OSIsoft historians, Bentley iTwin, Cognite and Atlantis NDT ERP. Full REST API and bulk data export — you keep your data in a format you can leave with.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Atlantis Digital Twin work in Delhi?

We start with a 3D scan of your asset (drone, laser, photogrammetry), build a CAD-fidelity model, and then overlay every NDT inspection event (UT thickness readings, TOFD/PAUT scans, MT/PT indications, RT defect maps). Inspection data updates the model in real-time and colour-codes condition zones for engineering review. Operators in Delhi use this to drive faster turnaround scoping, automated FFS evidence, and audit-grade regulatory reporting.

What does Digital Twin NDT cost in Delhi?

Atlantis Digital Twin is an affordable, accessible, fully customizable enterprise SaaS platform sized for up to 500 assets, with ASNT Level III consulting and unlimited NDT data ingest included. Enterprise tiers are available for multi-site fleets, and on-prem deployment is offered at the same price point. Request a Delhi-specific quote and we will model your asset count and data-volume requirements.

How long does deployment take in Delhi?

A typical first-asset deployment runs 8-12 weeks: 2 weeks model build, 2 weeks data integration, 2-4 weeks workflow configuration, 2 weeks user training. Multi-asset rollouts are sequenced asset-by-asset after the first deployment is live, with each subsequent asset typically taking 4-6 weeks once the platform is configured for your Delhi site.

Which NDT standards does the platform support in Delhi?

API 510 (pressure vessels), API 570 (piping), API 653 (storage tanks), API 579 FFS, API 581 RBI, ASME Section V articles 2/4/6/7, ISO 9712 personnel qualification, ASNT SNT-TC-1A, and local code requirements depending on Delhi's regulatory environment. Custom reporting templates can be configured for any additional national or operator-specific code.

Can Atlantis Digital Twin integrate with our existing CMMS in Delhi?

Yes. We support REST API hooks for IBM Maximo, SAP PM, IFS, Oracle EAM, and most major CMMS platforms. Work-order creation, asset master sync, anomaly hand-off into corrective work, and FFS evidence packaging for management-of-change submittals can all be automated, allowing your Delhi integrity team to focus on engineering judgement rather than data entry.
